classification.Preserved: Every observation required by the case is established from the frozen identity with an attributable public-language or approved carrier witness.
classification.Violated: A required observable differs, an invalid construction is accepted, or a semantic mutation is exposed, with an attributable witness and public reason code.
classification.Unknown: Identity, execution, parsing, extraction, dependency, opacity or budget prevents a sound decision. Unknown is fail-closed and cannot satisfy a mandatory case or reject a valid mutation.

observables.O-BINDING: math.mat is a callable function in the closed math module and constructs canonical MathMatrix identity rather than generic content or a pre-laid-out grid.
observables.O-SIGNATURE: The qualified function accepts variadic positional rows/cells and only delim, align, augment, gap, row-gap and column-gap as named arguments. Named arguments may precede positionals. rows:, unknown names and every duplicate named occurrence are rejected; no occurrence is ignored or truncated.
observables.O-ROWS: With no positional arguments or with only non-array values, the carrier contains exactly one row in source order; zero positionals yields one empty row. If any positional is an array, every positional must cast to array and each array becomes one row. Array cell values are displayed as Content exactly once.
observables.O-PADDING: Array rows are rectangularized to the maximum source-row width by appending Content::Empty only to shorter rows. Existing cells, empty input rows, row order and column order are preserved; scalar mode is not independently padded beyond its single row.
observables.O-DELIMITER: delim accepts none, a valid one-codepoint delimiter string or symbol with matching-pair inference, or an array of exactly two optional valid delimiters. It rejects invalid type, cardinality, codepoint count and non-delimiter math class. Optional sides and order remain distinct; defaults are ('(', ')').
observables.O-ALIGN: align accepts only horizontal start, left, center, right and end, preserves the chosen value and rejects vertical or unrelated alignments. The default is center. Without an ampersand boundary it positions each cell horizontally according to the effective alignment.
observables.O-GAPS: gap is an external shorthand expanded at construction or set-rule boundaries into row_gap and column_gap; it is never stored independently. A same-level row-gap or column-gap overrides shorthand only on its own axis regardless of named order. Both axes retain Rel<Length>, resolve against the exterior style, and default independently to 0.2em and 0.5em.
observables.O-AUGMENT-CAST: augment accepts none, a signed integer shorthand for one vertical offset with auto stroke, or a dictionary containing only hline, vline and stroke. Each line field accepts a signed integer or an ordered array of signed integers. Missing line fields are empty; missing stroke is auto. Unknown dictionary keys, invalid line values and invalid stroke values are rejected. Integer shorthand remains canonically distinguishable in repr when eligible.
observables.O-AUGMENT-CASCADE: Effective augment is derived without mutating the carrier. Omitted augment inherits the cascaded value. Explicit none removes any outer augment. Explicit integer/dict keeps its own hline/vline offsets and folds only its stroke with the outer stroke: a custom inner stroke folds with a custom outer stroke, while inner auto takes the outer stroke. Default is none.
observables.O-EXPLICITNESS: The carrier has independent delim, align, augment, row_gap and column_gap presence bits. Each constructor named occurrence sets exactly the causal field bits: gap sets both gap-axis bits, an axis-specific argument sets only that axis, and specific overrides do not clear the other bit. augment:none and values equal to defaults remain explicit. Set-derived values never set element bits.
observables.O-SET-PRECEDENCE: #set math.mat validates the same six named domains as the constructor, rejects unknown and duplicates, expands set gap to both axes with same-level specific overrides, and supplies cascade values without rewriting stored element fields. Effective values are element explicit, then cascade, then defaults; augment follows O-AUGMENT-CASCADE.
observables.O-ROUTE-CONVERGENCE: Qualified math.mat and bare mat delegate to one typed constructor and create equal complete carriers for equivalent occurrences. Neither route keeps a permissive legacy parser, pre-resolves layout, loses presence, nor changes the row-mode rule.
observables.O-EVALUATION-ONCE: Each syntactic positional and named value is evaluated exactly once in source order before common construction. Errors and spreads propagate; casts do not retry evaluation, and rejected arguments are not silently discarded.
observables.O-CARRIER: MathMatrix stores rectangular rows, optional delimiter sides, HAlign, optional typed augment with ordered signed hline/vline offsets and optional stroke, relative row and column gaps, and MathMatrixExplicit with five independent bits. Equality and hash include every stored value, nested order, optional side, stroke component and presence bit.
observables.O-WALKERS: Clone preserves the complete carrier. map_content recurses once through every cell in row-major order and preserves all non-content fields. map_text remains terminal. plain_text joins cells with comma-space and rows with semicolon-space without resolving cascade, offsets, stroke auto or MathAlignPoint.
observables.O-REPR: Canonical repr is mat(delim?, align?, augment?, row-gap?, column-gap?, rows: tuple-of-tuples), in that field order. Optional fields appear only from causal element presence; rows always appear. Zero input is rows: ((),). Padded cells appear empty. gap never appears. A single auto-stroke vline and no hline uses integer shorthand; other augment values use a canonical dict with ordered hline, vline and stroke, including explicit none.
observables.O-RECONSTRUCTION: apply_math_default, apply_math_style and every exhaustive Content reconstruction transform only cells where applicable and preserve row shape, optional delimiters, alignment, augment offsets/stroke, relative gaps and all five presence bits. They never materialize cascade, normalize signed offsets or split ampersands.
observables.O-ALIGN-POINT: MathAlignPoint remains structurally inside its source cell until matrix layout. The consumer splits each cell into alternating subcolumns, preserves P825 class-sensitive boundary spacing and aligns boundaries across rows. Explicit horizontal align applies when there is no boundary and does not erase ampersand behavior.
observables.O-LAYOUT-GEOMETRY: The layout uses denominator-style cells, resolves row/column gaps against the exterior style, places all rectangular cells, applies effective start|left|center|right|end alignment, centers the grid exactly once on the math axis, stretches each optional delimiter to the complete grid, and includes delimiter and grid extents without redundant padding.
observables.O-AUGMENT-GEOMETRY: Every effective horizontal and vertical augment offset produces one line at the middle of the corresponding inter-cell gap or accepted boundary. Negative offsets count from the end. Offsets 0 and n are valid borders. Auto stroke is 0.05em with square caps; a custom stroke preserves its resolved thickness, color and cap. Multiple lines and their declared order are not collapsed.
observables.O-OFFSET-VALIDATION: For a matrix with n rows or columns, an offset is accepted exactly when its positive value is at most n and its absolute value is at most n. Out-of-range horizontal and vertical offsets produce attributable dimension-specific diagnostics before drawing; no invalid line is clamped or ignored.
observables.O-COMPATIBILITY: The internal legacy constructor remains non-language surface and elevates old rows/delimiter/gap/augment inputs into the complete carrier without altering established old call-site geometry. The named P825/P912/P919/P923/P945/P1042 contracts remain intact.
observables.O-FAIL-CLOSED: Identity mismatch, opaque binding/carrier/cascade/evaluation/repr/layout/stroke observation, unsupported extraction, unreadable or truncated output, timeout, crash, OOM, swap, missing dependency or exhausted budget is Unknown. Unknown receives no acceptance or mutation credit, remains in every valid-mutation denominator and blocks mandatory and valid-mutation gates.

mutation_requirements.mutation: remove math.mat registration, register a non-function, or construct generic/pre-resolved content
change zero positionals from one empty row to zero rows
treat scalar positionals as separate rows or array positionals as one scalar row
allow mixed array/scalar mode by wrapping or flattening the scalar
omit ragged-row padding, prepend empties, pad to the wrong width or drop an empty row
collapse optional sides, skip pair inference, accept bad cardinality/class/codepoints or replace none with a sentinel glyph
accept vertical align, collapse one horizontal variant or always center
store gap redundantly, apply it to one axis only, let shorthand override a specific axis or make precedence depend on named order
collapse Rel<Length> to Length, swap row/column gaps or resolve against cell style
drop signedness/order, collapse hline and vline, accept unknown dict keys or substitute auto after invalid stroke
lose integer shorthand identity or print a multi-line/custom augment as an integer
let outer offsets replace explicit offsets, fail to inherit outer stroke for inner auto, or let outer augment survive explicit none
infer any presence bit from effective value, conflate augment omitted/none, or have gap set only one axis bit
accept invalid set values, ignore a set property, mutate element presence, or let cascade override explicit fields
retain permissive bare parsing, use a different row algorithm, or discard errors/duplicates on one route
evaluate an occurrence twice, reorder it, retry a cast expression or swallow a spread/error
omit any field, nested order, stroke component or explicitness bit from equality or hash
skip/reorder/double-visit a cell, mutate a non-content field, descend through map_text or alter plain_text separators
emit matrix, omit rows, print gap, reorder fields, hide explicit defaults/none, expose cascaded values or lose padded empties
drop/reset a carrier field or bit during apply_math_default, apply_math_style or exhaustive reconstruction
split ampersands before layout, ignore boundaries, remove P825 spacing or let align erase alternating subcolumns
use numerator/exterior cell style, swap axes, always center, add delimiter padding or apply axis centering twice
draw only one line, ignore hline, collapse duplicate/ordered offsets, place a line at a cell edge rather than the middle gap, or omit border lines
mis-normalize negative offsets, use non-square auto caps, wrong auto thickness, or discard custom stroke thickness/color/cap
use strict interior-only bounds, accept magnitude above dimension, clamp, ignore, or validate hline against columns/vline against rows
break a P825/P912/P919/P923/P945/P1042 control or change old wrapper geometry
grant Unknown acceptance/mutation credit, remove it from the valid denominator or fail to block a mandatory/valid-mutation gate

consumers.obligation: register math.mat, enforce the closed typed signature, normalize rows/fields/shorthand and construct the complete carrier
converge bare mat on the common constructor, preserve occurrence order and evaluate once
emit canonical optional fields, augment morphology and rectangular rows from causal presence
validate/cascade only six fields, expand shorthand, fold augment stroke and avoid fabricated presence
resolve complete carrier, align/gaps/ampersands, validate and render augment lines/stroke, preserve established geometry
keep static thin dispatch and reconstruct the complete matrix carrier without field loss
provide complete constructor plus narrow legacy wrapper and preserve carrier in exhaustive Content operations
define complete rows/delim/align/augment/gaps/explicit carrier with equality, hash and walkers

exhaustive_wiring.fail_closed: Any additional productive consumer, non-mechanical existing-test repair, wildcard suppressing review, missing owner L0, public alternative row carrier, generalized delimiter/stroke expansion or semantic change outside the eight-consumer allowlist invalidates admission until obligation authority reviews the expanded surface. Mechanical call-site repairs may use only the compatibility wrapper and must preserve public behavior.

calibration.focused_first: Run only affected cases plus nearest positive/negative/opaque boundary controls until the changed slice passes.
calibration.full_gate: Run the whole corpus only after focal success, before sealing, and during final verification in all three frozen orders.
calibration.stop_rule: Two consecutive revisions with the same classification vector and dominant cause, a non-monotonic positive/opaque tradeoff, mutation score already 1.0 with only control churn, missing public information, or marginal cost beyond budget requires redesign or an inconclusive result; it never authorizes loosening or Unknown credit.

gates.preseal: Manifest, contract, oracle suite, mutation suite, executor bindings, hashes, classification reason codes and three execution orders are frozen before candidate admission.

discriminatory.score_formula: valid semantic mutations classified Violated / all valid semantic mutations

red: binding and row/padding/carrier tests fail attributable to the frozen baseline
casts, duplicates, explicitness and gap precedence fail attributable
augment integer/dict/none, offsets/stroke and cascade fail attributable
alignment/gap/augment geometry and ampersand tests fail attributable
final: physical mutation campaign M01-M27 at score 1.0

claim_boundary: This contract discriminates only the approved P1431 math.mat fragment. It does not classify a future candidate, emit a seal or verdict, authorize another math route or generalized delimiter/stroke carrier, prove general Typst or render-byte equivalence, treat Rust mechanics as language observables, or attest workspace isolation.
